function.arguments: {"message":"To avoid being billed for two seats, simply reassign the seat *before* the next invoice date. Meridian’s billing runs on the invoice date shown in Settings → Billing → Plan (next to “Next invoice”). Any same‑cycle seat reassignment is counted at the invoice date, so the next invoice will reflect the new seat count as a single seat—not both the old and the new. Just make the swap in your seat‑management screen before that date and you’ll be billed correctly."}
